reform_history.notes: NDPI (mineral extraction tax) replaced multiple legacy Soviet-era royalties. Rate linked to oil price and Urals differential. Simplified collection but increased effective rate for high-price environments.

reform_history.event: Windfall tax on oil export revenues
reform_history.notes: Following invasion of Ukraine, Russia imposed additional export duty on oil revenues above threshold. Combined with NDPI, effective government take on marginal barrel reached ~80%+ at >$90/bbl.
